limits: Old-head hosted results do not qualify the integration. Fresh exact pushed-head/current-main checks, e2e, native architectures, ownership, PC and all package modes remain necessary.
Other positive old-head cases contain forced stops; scoped Deck Settings success does not establish global clean shutdown.
Local integration native controls run only AMD64; no real upload, settings write, browser, Steam CEF, managed Frame, wearer/controller or release proof.
The production installer method checks 37 pinned fixtures without executing official plugin backends; it is not full e2e.
